_readme: FROZEN GOLDEN RETRIEVAL SET v1 -- Qdrant read-cutover gate for the production RAG path.
Format: { cases: [...] } consumed by scripts/eval/rag-production-eval.ts via loadFrozenProductionRagGoldenSet
(underscore-prefixed top-level keys are documentation; the loader reads only `cases`).
Each case's expectedEvidenceRefs contain (a) one or two exact-chunk refs (accession + section + chunk_ordinal + content_hash)
and (b) one section-level ref (accession + section) for partial credit when a sibling chunk of the same
filing section is retrieved instead of the exact chunk.  Recall@K therefore grades 0 / 0.5 / 1.0 per case
(0 / 1/3 / 2/3 / 1.0 for the one case with two exact refs).
authoritativeAsOf is the simulated proposer decision time: always at or after the evidence chunk's
acceptance_datetime, spread from 2025-09 to 2026-08.  pit-asof cases pin a date BETWEEN two filings of the
same symbol so the newer filing (named in notes) must not be retrieved under strictAsOf.
True negative-control cases (queries with no valid evidence) are deliberately absent: the harness requires
non-empty expectedEvidenceRefs and has no must-not-match scoring; PIT controls are the supported negative form.
8-K coverage caveat: 8-K content in this corpus is EDGAR filing-index scrape and exhibit listings, not
press-release prose, so the four 8k-catalyst cases are intrinsically hard and score accordingly.
under test (for Qdrant, the adapter's knob env plus QDRANT_URL / QDRANT_API_KEY; see _provenance).
RUN (verified invocation shape, 2026-08-31): NODE_OPTIONS="--conditions react-server" is REQUIRED (vector-db
imports server-only modules; without the condition the import throws).  Backend knob: RAG_VECTOR_READ_BACKEND=qdrant
(or server knob / env RAG_VECTOR_READ_QDRANT=1) plus QDRANT_URL and QDRANT_API_KEY -- see src/lib/vector-store/qdrant-read.ts.
Use --user <non-local id> (e.g. rag-eval-qdrant) so shared-operator-infra keys resolve from env instead of a stale
per-user DB row; embeds need a valid SILICONFLOW_API_KEY in env (openrouter is per-user-only and ignores env by design).
RAG_VECTOR_READ_BACKEND=qdrant QDRANT_URL=... QDRANT_API_KEY=... SILICONFLOW_API_KEY=... \
NODE_OPTIONS="--conditions react-server" npx tsx scripts/eval/rag-production-eval.ts \
--input scripts/eval/golden/rag-production-golden-v1.json --allow-live --limit 8 \
--user rag-eval-qdrant --profile qdrant-read-cutover-v1 --output <report.json>
The cutover gate metric is Recall@8 overall and per category (limit 8).

_provenance.author: CLAUDE (claude/qdrant-read-cutover lane)
_provenance.derivedFrom: live Qdrant http://100.69.77.26:6333 collection 'socratic-trade' (801,239 points, 1024-dim cosine, int8 scalar quantization)
_provenance.honestyNote: These cases were derived by sampling the QDRANT COPY of the corpus (scroll + facet over payloads) while Pinecone read units were exhausted (Aug 2026).  Evidence coordinates (accession/section/chunk_ordinal/ content_hash) are identical across both stores because Qdrant payloads carry the full Pinecone metadata, but the SELECTION of cases could not be cross-checked against Pinecone reads.  This gate therefore measures ABSOLUTE recall/ranking of whichever backend the run points at.  A Pinecone-vs-Qdrant parity baseline should be re-recorded when Pinecone read units reset (Sep 1, 2026) if parity evidence is still wanted.
_provenance.samplingMethod: Filtered scrolls by (symbol, doc_type, section) across doc_type in {10-k, 10-q, 8-k, earnings-transcript}, symbols spread across the corpus's largest holdings/major tickers plus small-caps (NKLR), max 2 cases per accession.

corpusFacts.transcriptTimestampCaveat: Many roic-earnings-transcript chunks carry acceptance_datetime = ingest time (2026-08-16/17), not the call date; transcript cases therefore use authoritativeAsOf >= the ingest stamp except where the acceptance stamp is the real call date.
